---
title: "Checkin"
description: "Those endpoints perform check-in procedures, a'ka firmware verification and setup of RTC based on trusted data."
---

:::info
These two endpoints are wide open and do not need any authorisation data.
:::

#### Phase 1 - Challenge

## Checkin challange

<Endpoint method="GET" path="/api/system/checkin" operationId="getSystemCheckin" />

Get a device check-in challenge data.

#### Response status code

<ResponseCodes>
<ResponseCode code="200" title="Successful operation">

```json
{
  "check": "eyJlY2RoIjoieDI1NTE5IiwidHlwIjoiSldUIiwiYWxnIjoiSFMyNTYifQ..dn2cwBODoUKkGKrr92IW13NgVg7j-h6VGO-tnADqins"
}
```

</ResponseCode>
</ResponseCodes>

#### Response data for successful operation

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `check` | String | Check-In challenge data generated by HEM |

#### Phase 2 - Response

## Checkin response

<Endpoint method="POST" path="/api/system/checkin" operationId="postSystemCheckin" />

Process server response for the device `check` challenge.

#### Headers

| Name                                           | Type   | Description      |
| ---------------------------------------------- | ------ | ---------------- |
| Content-Type<Req /> | String | application/json |

#### Request Body

| Name                                        | Type   | Description                                           |
| ------------------------------------------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `checked`<Req /> | String | Checkin data sent by the backend server |

#### Response status code

<ResponseCodes>
<ResponseCode code="200" title="Successful operation">

```json
{
  "status": "OK"
}
```

</ResponseCode>
<ResponseCode code="400" title="Incorrect argument(s)" />
<ResponseCode code="401" title="Provided data validation failed" />
</ResponseCodes>

#### Response data for successful operation

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `newcrt` | String | Status of the TLS certificate update. |
| `newfws` | String | Info about the new firmware version. |
| `newuis` | String | Info about the new Manager version (on Encedo PPA only). |
| `status` | String | Checkin status - general information. |

#### Log entries

| Event | Result | Source |
|---|---|---|
| LOG_TYPE_RTC_SET | LOG_RESULT_OK | 200 (if RTC is been updated) |
| LOG_TYPE_SHUTDOWN | LOG_RESULT_OK | 200 (if the device shutdown or locked) |
